arms.A1_prng: mulberry32(seed 20261018 + k) byte stream -> seedFn, n=10 planes (seeds k=0..9). The status-quo constructor AND the noise-floor population.
arms.A2_qrng: comet-qrng-v1 ONE job, mode emu, output_bytes 49152 (48 KiB), include_raw_counts false -> 40960 conditioned bytes consumed as 10 planes' seedFn journal (4096 B each), n=10. The certified-constructor arm. Bell witness + min-entropy certificate receipted in the seed receipt; provenance (mode/backend) reported, never hidden.
arms.A3_qblur: tau-field: A2's plane bytes' tau bits VERBATIM (tau provenance identical to A2 — the blur touches ONLY the d-field). d-field: A2's plane d-values (64x64 grid of integers 0..63) -> blur-core-v1 EXACT mode (shots OMITTED — deterministic quantum operator), strength 0.5, reach default -> output floats RESCALED to input max (receipted engine law) -> re-quantize round-half-up, clamp [0,63]. n=5 planes (5 x 1-credit jobs). The quantum-shaped-geometry arm.
arms.A3S_shuffled_control: A3's d-value MULTISET, spatial correlation destroyed by a fixed-seed deterministic permutation (mulberry32(20261018), Fisher-Yates — the E-Q9-DT shuffle idiom: the permutation key is NOT derived from the stream). tau-field identical to A3's. n=5, 0 credits. THE SHARP CONTROL: same marginals as A3, no correlation — separates 'the blur shifted the marginals' from 'the blur's correlation structure carries signal'.

design_frozen.populations: A1 n=10, A2 n=10, A3 n=5, A3S n=5. Cross-arm comparisons use population statistics; every plane individually hash-journaled.
design_frozen.moth_budget_law: HARD CAPS in the runner: max 1 comet job (5 credits), max 5 blur jobs (5 credits), total 10 credits. Fail-closed: unreachable API yields DETERMINISTIC LABELED MOCK planes (live:false/mock:true everywhere — a mock never pretends to be quantum) and the round degrades to a plumbing test, honestly receipted. No retry burn past the caps.

metrics.d_histogram_wasserstein: per plane per checkpoint: 64-bin d-value histogram (normalized) -> Wasserstein-1 distance vs the A1 population leave-one-out reference at the same t.
metrics.tau_total_variation: per plane per checkpoint: 4-bin tau fractions -> total variation distance vs the A1 leave-one-out reference.
metrics.morans_i: per plane per checkpoint: Moran's I (rook-4 lag-1, torus wrap) on the d-field. The correlation-structure instrument: A3 should start HIGH (blur = smooth), A3S starts ~ A1's level (shuffled), and the question is whether A3's I decays to the A1 floor and when.
metrics.twin_event_rate: kernel twin events per tick at each checkpoint window (the event stream the kernel itself emits — no re-implementation).
metrics.saturation_fraction: fraction of cells at d == 63 per checkpoint.
metrics.plane_hash: sha256 of the packed plane at every checkpoint (the determinism receipt AND the all-distinct sanity check).
metrics.noise_floor: A1 leave-one-out: for each A1 plane, distance to the mean of the OTHER NINE; floor = 95th percentile per metric per checkpoint. The floor IS the threshold — no threshold you had to fit.

hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H1_qrng_prng_equivalence: LIVES iff A2's every per-metric per-checkpoint population distance <= the A1 noise floor (95th pct). DIES on any excursion with the metric and tick named. Registered death candidates: (a) comet's Toeplitz-extracted stream carries measurable structure mulberry32 lacks (would itself be a finding about the certified source); (b) an artifact of the 40960-of-49152 byte consumption window.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H2_washout: LIVES iff at t=64 EVERY cross-arm distance (A2, A3, A3S vs A1 floor) is <= floor on every metric. DIES on any metric above floor at t=64 — with autopsy naming metric, tick, and the A3-vs-A3S decomposition (marginals vs correlation). Registered death candidates: (a) the blur's rescale-to-max leaves the d-field pinned at a saturation outlier that the tick dynamics cannot erase (saturationFraction carries a permanent shift); (b) Moran's I decays slower than 64 ticks (long-lived quantum-shaped geometry — the interesting death); (c) tau-marginal asymmetries in the comet stream persist.
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.H3_early_fingerprint: LIVES iff A3's t=0 histogram distance AND Moran's I distance both exceed floor (the fingerprint exists before dynamics). DIES if the blur at strength 0.5 is already indistinguishable from noise (would send the round back to the strength ladder, honestly receipted as a design miss).
hypotheses_and_verdict_rules.C11_verdict: C11 LIVES iff H1 AND H2 hold AND determinism floors hold. Wash-out tick T* = the first checkpoint where A3's Moran's I distance <= floor AND stays <= floor at every later checkpoint. C11 DIES otherwise with the full autopsy. Either verdict ships: a LIVE C11 prices 'the constructor does not matter past t=T*'; a DEAD C11 prices exactly which constructor signature survives — both are boundary-map entries.

floors_frozen.EQ20_F0: determinism: every plane (all 30) constructed twice from its journaled source and ticked to t=64 — byte-identical plane-hash sequences, else VOID.
floors_frozen.EQ20_F1: kernel-real by construction: the runner imports qthe.mjs and calls tick() — no transcription exists in this experiment.
floors_frozen.EQ20_F2: QRNG authenticity: the comet job's result carries bell_witness.S > 2 (classical bound) AND a min-entropy certificate field, else the A2/A3 arms are VOID (no silent classical downgrade — halt LOUD, receipt, re-register).
floors_frozen.EQ20_F3: blur exactness: every blur job runs with shots OMITTED (the engine's exact mode) AND its output shape equals its input shape (64x64), else the fallback amendment fires BEFORE any data row.
floors_frozen.EQ20_F4: all-distinct sanity: no two planes share a full plane-hash sequence unless they share constructor AND seed (0 expected collisions across 30 planes).
floors_frozen.EQ20_F5: A3S marginal identity: A3S's d-value histogram == A3's EXACTLY per plane (the control's premise), else the control is broken, LOUD.
